اعتنقوا (form VIII)
# اِعْتَنَقُوا (iʕtanaqū) /iʕ.ta.na.quː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِعْتَنَقَ (iʕtanaqa)
# اُعْتُنِقُوا (uʕtuniqū) /uʕ.tu.ni.quː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِعْتَنَقَ (iʕtanaqa)
# اِعْتَنِقُوا (iʕtaniqū) /iʕ.ta.ni.quː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِعْتَنَقَ (iʕtanaqa)
